problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Unconstrained differentiable convex minimization on a second-countable real Hilbert space E. The gradient is globally L-Lipschitz, and a minimizer x* exists with ‖x0−x*‖≤R. L,R>0; strong convexity is not required.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call returns g(x,ξ) using a fresh IID seed, with E[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x). The jointly measurable oracle has integrable replies and finite central α-moments. Only gradient samples are supplied. All Params, including L,R,σ,σ0,α,ε,δ,x0, are public; f and the oracle distribution are hidden. Budgets cap total individual oracle calls.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AffineMomentConvex.lean: IsFiniteMomentOracle; spec.Public, publicInput, admissible; LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean: IID; LongTails/Template.lean: executeWithTrace, Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x, E‖g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)‖^α≤σ0^α+σ^α‖∇f(x)‖^α, with 1<α≤2 and σ,σ0≥0. Infinite variance is permitted when α<2; no exponential-tail assumption is imposed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: The central noise moment has additive and gradient-dependent multiplicative components. Neither a uniform noise bound nor an almost-sure relative-error bound is required. The ambient Hilbert space need not be finite-dimensional.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return a measurable E-valued output x̂ satisfying f(x̂)−f(x*)≤ε on the success event, for a global minimizer x*. No particular iterate or averaging rule is prescribed.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(f(x̂)−f(x*)>ε)≤δ, with ε>0 and 0<δ<1. Probability includes algorithm randomness and the IID oracle sequence under a fixed oracle-call cap.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/AffineMomentConvex.lean: spec.valid, successful; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, executeWithTrace.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: Smooth convex minimization is classical, but the affine gradient-dependent central α-moment oracle, allowing infinite variance, is a substantive variant of the standard uniformly bounded-variance formulation.

descriptionHtml:
Convex Minimization with Affine Moments

We minimize a differentiable convex function f:E→R on a separable real Hilbert space E. Its gradient is L-Lipschitz, with L>0, and a given point x0∈E lies within distance R>0 of a minimizer x⋆. The oracle returns unbiased stochastic gradients from independent, identically distributed samples, with error α-moment bounded by σ0α+σα∥∇f(x)∥α at x, where 1<α≤2 and σ0,σ≥0. For ε>0 and δ∈(0,1), the goal is a measurable output x¯∈E satisfying P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤δ, where P is the joint law of sampling and independent algorithm randomness.

The optimization problem is minx∈Ef(x). The norm ∥⋅∥ is induced by the inner product on E, which is equipped with its Borel sigma-algebra. Let Ω be a measurable sample space. The algorithm receives E, Ω, L, R, σ, σ0, α, ε, δ, and x0; the objective is accessed through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Convexity and smoothness). The function f is Fréchet differentiable everywhere on E. For every x,y∈E and t∈[0,1], f((1−t)x+ty)≤(1−t)f(x)+tf(y),∥∇f(x)−∇f(y)∥≤L∥x−y∥.

Assumption 2 (Initial distance). There exists x⋆∈E such that f(x⋆)≤f(x)for every x∈E,∥x0−x⋆∥≤R.

Assumption 3 (Sampling and affine moment bound). There exist a probability measure ν on Ω and a jointly measurable map g:E×Ω→E. At the kth query x∈E, the oracle returns g(x,ξk), where the measurable random variables (ξk)k≥0 are mutually independent with common law ν, and are independent of the algorithm’s randomness. For every x∈E, the map g(x,⋅) is Bochner integrable and ∥g(x,⋅)−∇f(x)∥α is integrable with respect to ν. They satisfy Eξ∼ν[g(x,ξ)]=∇f(x),Eξ∼ν[∥g(x,ξ)−∇f(x)∥α]≤σ0α+σα∥∇f(x)∥α.

Queries may be made at any point of E. After the allotted oracle calls, the output x¯ must be measurable and satisfy the high-probability objective-gap requirement P{f(x¯)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤δ.

comparisonHtml:
Convex differentiable f on a separable real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure; globally L-Lipschitz gradient and a minimizer x⋆ with ∥x0−x⋆∥≤R. IID samples have law ν; the jointly measurable oracle is integrable and satisfies ∫g(x,ω)dν=∇f(x) and ∫∥g(x,ω)−∇f(x)∥pdν≤σ0p+σp∥∇f(x)∥p, with integrable moments. Here L,R,ε>0, σ0,σ≥0, 1<p≤2, and 0<δ<1 are supplied parameters. Target: measurable output with P{f(out)−f(x⋆)>ε}≤δ under the IID execution law P. Costs count all individual stochastic-gradient replies. Literature comparisons are on the common finite-dimensional restriction.

import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex

open MeasureTheory

namespace LongTails.Setups.AffineMomentConvex

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [linearE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [completeE : CompleteSpace E]
  [countableE : SecondCountableTopology E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  R : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  σ0 : ℝ
  α : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  x0 : E

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.linearE Params.completeE Params.countableE
  Params.measurableE Params.borelE Params.measurableΩ

structure IsFiniteMomentOracle {E Ω : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] [MeasurableSpace E] [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (p : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure p] (f : E → ℝ)
    (g : E → Ω → E) (α σ σ0 : ℝ) : Prop where
  measurable : Measurable (fun z : E × Ω => g z.1 z.2)
  integrable : ∀ x, Integrable (g x) p
  unbiased : ∀ x, (∫ ω, g x ω ∂p) = gradient f x
  integrable_moment : ∀ x, Integrable (fun ω => ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ α) p
  moment : ∀ x, (∫ ω, ‖g x ω - gradient f x‖ ^ α ∂p) ≤
    σ0 ^ α + σ ^ α * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ α

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance p := p.E → ℝ
  Query p := p.E
  Reply p := p.E
  Output p := p.E
  publicInput p := p
  valid q := 0 < q.L ∧ 0 < q.R ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ0 ∧ 1 < q.α ∧ q.α ≤ 2 ∧
    0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (g : q.E → q.Ω → q.E) (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω)
      (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
    LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
      (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
    O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
          law := P
          answer := fun _ (_, x) seed => g x seed } ∧
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ f ∧
    (∀ x, HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) ∧
    (∀ x y, ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ q.L * ‖x - y‖) ∧
    (∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧ ‖q.x0 - xstar‖ ≤ q.R) ∧
    IsFiniteMomentOracle (p : Measure _) f g q.α q.σ q.σ0
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ ∃ xstar, IsMinOn f Set.univ xstar ∧
      (∫ ω, (if q.ε < f (output ω) - f xstar then (1 : ℝ) else 0) ∂(P : Measure _)) ≤ q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.AffineMomentConvex
